The workbook generation failed because critical data cells in the 'Task' sheet were empty (None) instead of containing the expected calculated values.
The pytest suite failed with multiple AssertionErrors in test_lookup_blocks and test_derived_values_and_stats. Specifically, cells in ranges H12:L17 (top block) and H35:L40 (net metric) returned None instead of the expected float values. For example, H12 expected 612.5 and H35 expected 4.4999, but both were empty. Ensure the logic populates these specific coordinate ranges in the 'Task' worksheet.
